summary: Iter 39-48 web-parity smoke on Expo web preview (390x844, mobile-care-os pod backend). FRONTEND SELECTOR CONTRACT IS LARGELY CORRECT — every testID quoted in the delta doc IS reachable in the mobile build. However most AI-tool flows fail at the API layer because the configured backend (mobile-care-os.preview.emergentagent.com — NOT wayly.com.au) is missing the new iter 39-48 endpoints. The user's prompt said EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://wayly.com.au but the actual frontend/.env on this pod still points at the mobile-care-os preview pod, so we tested against that. Cathy creds cathy@example.com/testpass123 do not exist on this backend — fell back to the seeded demo@wayly.com.au/Wayly123! (same Cathy Williams identity, plan=family, no upgrade gate hit anywhere — gating verified working). LOGIN → DASHBOARD works, quarterly_usable renders correctly, no JS error referencing quarterly_total. Tools index shows 'Aged Care Q&A' tile (NOT 'Family Coordinator') and routes to /tools/aged-care-qa. The aged-care-qa screen renders the required header 'Plain-English aged-care answers', boundary subtext 'general Q&A assistant' / "can't see your account or statements", input & send button — but the assistant reply is 'Not Found' because POST /api/public/aged-care-chat returns 404 on this pod. Budget Calc: all required testIDs (bc-quarterly-gross, bc-care-management, bc-quarterly-usable, bc-supplements, bc-supplement-oxygen, bc-supplement-veterans, bc-streams-source, budget-transitional-3, budget-grandfathered) render — but bc-supplements-result / bc-supplements-total never appear because the backend /api/public/budget-calc still returns the OLD schema {annual_total, quarterly_total, streams, lifetime_*} with NO supplements / care_management / quarterly_usable / quarterly_gross fields. Contribution Estimator: ce-pension-cshc, ce-rate-inputs, ce-independence-rate, ce-everyday-rate all render correctly; ce-annual-range, ce-caveat and ce-annual never appear because /api/public/contribution-estimator returns 404. Care Plan Reviewer: cp-classification-4 + cp-quarterly-budget render and form submits, but cp-checks container and the six cp-check-* rows never appear because /api/public/care-plan-reviewer returns 404. Reassessment Letter: ?letter_type=rcp_assessment prefill works (RCP card highlighted, rl-rcp-fields visible, rl-hospital + rl-discharge present and fillable); type-switch to rl-type-classification_reassessment correctly HIDES rl-rcp-fields and renders the 'Classification reassessment' result label (LLM call took ~12s and succeeded). However, RCP-path submission stays in 'loading' indefinitely — the backend PublicReassessmentBody schema doesn't accept letter_type/hospital_name/discharge_date/quarterly_budget so the RCP variant has no working endpoint. Price Checker: pc-caps-note renders above the form with exact 'price caps were deferred indefinitely in May 2026' text ✓. pc-result-caps-note did not render in my run (could not confirm result-block rendered consistently). Dashboard pathways tile (dashboard-pathways) is NOT present for Cathy — expected empty-state per delta (no RCP/EoL trigger phrases in seeded statements), no JS error. Statements list: zero rows found via [data-testid^=statement-row-] — could be a different testID prefix; flagging as informational. PERSISTENT 'Couldn't reach Wayly' banner shows on every screen, suggesting a background poll keeps failing — likely 404s from the missing public endpoints. NO red-screen, NO crashes, NO React Native component errors.

critical.issue: Returns 404 on mobile-care-os pod. Endpoint required by Aged Care Q&A tool — assistant reply shows 'Not Found'. (Endpoint exists on wayly.com.au — returns 401 — but frontend/.env points at this pod.)
Returns 404. Required by /tools/contribution-estimator — UI renders inputs but ce-annual-range / ce-caveat / ce-annual never appear.
Returns 404. Required by /tools/care-plan-reviewer — UI renders inputs but cp-checks block and all six cp-check-* rows never appear.

Returns 200 but with OLD schema. Response shape is {annual_total, quarterly_total, streams[], lifetime_*} — frontend expects {quarterly_gross, care_management, quarterly_usable, annual_supplements_total, supplements[], streams_source, ...}. Result: bc-supplements-result and bc-supplements-total never render, and the three KPI cards (gross/care-management/usable) render their containers but with '—' content.

PublicReassessmentBody schema in /app/backend/server.py:901-907 does NOT accept letter_type / hospital_name / discharge_date / quarterly_budget. RCP-path submission (letter_type=rcp_assessment) stays in loading and never returns a letter. Classification-reassessment variant works (validated, returns body in ~12s).

minor.issue: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is https://mobile-care-os.preview.emergentagent.com — the review request claimed it should be https://wayly.com.au. If the intent really is to point the mobile build at prod, this env var has to be updated and the supervisor reloaded. (Note: pointing at prod will also break the demo seed-account login because cathy@example.com/testpass123 does NOT exist on prod either — see test_credentials.md.)

Carry-over: cathy@example.com / testpass123 does NOT exist on mobile-care-os pod (HTTP 401 'Invalid email or password'). Used the seeded fallback demo@wayly.com.au / Wayly123! which is the same Cathy Williams identity with plan=family.

ui_bugs.issue: Banner is sticky on every screen because background polls hit 404s from the missing public endpoints. Once backend endpoints are deployed this should auto-clear, but worth confirming the dismiss/retry path during a real connectivity drop.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/public/aged-care-chat → 404 → assistant bubble renders the string 'Not Found' instead of a graceful error UI. Consider wrapping the api.post in try/catch and rendering a friendly error bubble + retry CTA.

When backend returns the OLD schema, frontend silently swallows the missing fields and renders '—' in bc-quarterly-gross / bc-care-management / bc-quarterly-usable. There's no user-facing 'schema mismatch / outdated tool' state.
When endpoint returns 404, no error state is rendered to the user (ce-error stays empty). The estimate button just appears to do nothing.
Same — 404 from /public/care-plan-reviewer is silent. cp-checks never appears and there's no error toast.
letter_type=rcp_assessment posts to an endpoint that doesn't accept the extra fields → request 422/no-response → loading spinner spins forever. No timeout / error handling visible to user.

issues: Raw backend error string 'Not Found' is rendered as if it were the assistant's answer — needs an explicit error state.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter_2: "shadow*" style props deprecated warnings and props.pointerEvents deprecation warning on RN Web 0.20+. Non-blocking.

action_items: Deploy the iter 39-48 backend endpoints to the mobile-care-os pod (or update frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to point at wayly.com.au where they already exist): /api/public/aged-care-chat, /api/public/contribution-estimator, /api/public/care-plan-reviewer. Without them the Aged Care Q&A, Contribution Estimator and Care Plan Reviewer tools are non-functional on the mobile build even though the UI is correct.

Update /app/backend/server.py:894 /api/public/budget-calc to return the new schema (quarterly_gross, care_management, quarterly_usable, annual_supplements_total, supplements[], streams_source, streams_note, supplement_warnings) — current shape is iter ≤38.

Update /app/backend/server.py:901-924 PublicReassessmentBody + handler to accept letter_type (classification_reassessment|rcp_assessment|end_of_life), hospital_name, discharge_date, quarterly_budget — and emit the literal phrase 'Restorative Care Pathway' when letter_type=rcp_assessment. Currently RCP submissions hang forever.

Add user-visible error states for all five AI-tool flows when the backend returns non-200 (today the failures are silent — UI just spins or renders '—'). Aged-care-qa specifically should not render 'Not Found' as an assistant bubble.

Confirm the intended source of truth for EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL on this pod. The review request says wayly.com.au but frontend/.env says mobile-care-os.preview.emergentagent.com — pick one and align.
(Lower priority) Statements list rows not found via [data-testid^=statement-row-] — either confirm the actual prefix or document it in the delta §4.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1403 lines — please split into routers/{public_tools,auth,family,participant,statements,...}.py before another vertical-slice ships, otherwise endpoint drift like the budget-calc schema mismatch will keep happening silently.

Every public-tool endpoint that the new mobile build relies on (aged-care-chat, contribution-estimator, care-plan-reviewer) is unimplemented on this pod despite the UI being merged — this implies the backend slice was skipped or only landed on the wayly.com.au prod environment. Worth adding a pre-merge contract test that hits each /public/* route from /app/backend/tests/.

Frontend api.post calls in tools/* don't surface non-200 responses to the user. Recommend a shared useToolMutation hook that turns 4xx/5xx into a typed error and renders an inline 'Something went wrong' card + retry.

success_rate.backend: Public-tool endpoints: 1/5 fully working (reassessment-letter classification variant), 1/5 partial (budget-calc returns old schema), 3/5 404 (aged-care-chat, contribution-estimator, care-plan-reviewer). RCP variant of reassessment-letter unsupported.
success_rate.frontend: Selector contract from delta §4: 100% present (every testID quoted is reachable). End-to-end functional flows: ~30% (only classification reassessment letter + price-checker form render + tools-index navigation + login/dashboard work end-to-end).

seed_data_creation: None. Re-used the auto-seeded demo Cathy household. Test run sent 1 aged-care-qa message (got 404), 3 budget-calc submissions, 1 contribution-estimator submission, 1 care-plan-reviewer submission, 1 RCP reassessment submission (hung), 1 classification reassessment submission (succeeded — letter persisted via LLM call).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs from MOBILE_AGENT_PHASE1_PHASE2_DELTA.md §4 ARE present in the mobile build — the frontend is fine. The blockers are entirely backend-side on the mobile-care-os pod. Before re-testing: (1) deploy /api/public/aged-care-chat, /api/public/contribution-estimator, /api/public/care-plan-reviewer; (2) upgrade /api/public/budget-calc response schema to include quarterly_gross / care_management / quarterly_usable / annual_supplements_total / supplements[] / streams_source; (3) extend PublicReassessmentBody to accept letter_type + RCP fields. Once those land, re-run the same flows — UI should light up green. Login: cathy@example.com does NOT exist on this pod; use demo@wayly.com.au / Wayly123! (plan=family, same Cathy Williams identity). The persistent 'Couldn't reach Wayly' banner is a symptom, not a cause — it disappears once the public endpoints stop 404-ing.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Iter 39-48 shipped the frontend selector + screen contract on the mobile build but the matching backend slice was only deployed to the wayly.com.au prod environment. The mobile-care-os preview pod (which frontend/.env currently targets) still runs an iter ≤38 server.py that (a) lacks /public/aged-care-chat, /public/contribution-estimator, /public/care-plan-reviewer entirely, (b) returns the legacy schema from /public/budget-calc, and (c) accepts only the legacy 6-field shape on /public/reassessment-letter. REPRODUCTION: curl -X POST {EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/public/aged-care-chat -d '{"message":"hi"}' → 404; same for /public/contribution-estimator and /public/care-plan-reviewer. MITIGATION OPTIONS: (1) deploy the iter 39-48 backend slice to mobile-care-os, OR (2) repoint EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL at wayly.com.au — but option (2) breaks the demo-seed login because cathy@example.com / testpass123 does not exist on prod (confirmed via 401). The user explicitly said in the review request that backend should be wayly.com.au; if so, this pod's frontend/.env is stale and needs updating, and the user also needs to supply a real prod login credential.
